PG1.name: One final full regression run
PG1.check: Run .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -rfE -p no:cacheprovider once after focused fixes; reuse the result across checks. No Orient/Implement/fresh-verifier repeats.

PG2.name: Approved acceptance coverage
PG2.check: Reuse current focused/default-suite results; run only uncovered required acceptance or relevant slow tests before the final full run.

PG5.name: Declared goldens and golden coverage
PG5.check: phase_tool.py golden-diff --format json; reuse final PG1 golden-test results.

PG6.name: Architecture and layering coverage
PG6.check: Reuse final PG1 architecture results; preserve explicit baseline exceptions.

PG8.name: Planning/skill consistency
PG8.check: phase_tool.py check --all; reuse final PG1 skill-fact results. No live eval unless requested.

PG11.name: Cited result paths exist
PG11.check: phase_tool.py evidence-check --phase NN --format json once; mechanical path check only, no review loop.

PG12.name: Approved outcome targets
PG12.check: Reuse required focused/integration test results for plan targets; no separate replay/benchmark campaign unless explicitly requested.

PG13.name: Optional code review
PG13.check: Not required by default. If requested or needed for a concrete correctness concern, inspect the relevant diff once and use focused tests only.

PG14.name: No TODO, stub or NotImplemented in new code
PG14.check: grep files changed in the phase for TODO|FIXME|XXX|NotImplementedError|raise NotImplemented|# stub; no hits in product code
